note: B34-DEF-001. This file exists so tooling can tell, mechanically, whether a checkout is the canonical backend deployment authority rather than a mobile integration branch that happens to carry a copy of supabase/functions. Its presence with role=backend-deployment-authority is what scripts/deploy-edge-functions.js requires before it will run at all. Mobile branches (integration/ios-build34-full-upgrade, integration/android-build34-full-upgrade, and their descendants) intentionally do NOT carry this file, or carry docs/BACKEND_DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORITY.md's non-authoritative pointer instead -- see that doc for why.

notGoverned.note: Functions deployed on staging that this authority's tree does not (and, for some, cannot) contain source for. Recorded so nobody mistakes 'not in this manifest' for 'safe to ignore'.

websitePrivacyStack.reason: Documented in docs/staging-rebuild/backend-authority-manifest.md as the website privacy stack, deliberately untouched by the mobile-app backend rebuild. Source lives outside this repository's supabase/functions tree.

stagingToolingOutsideThisTree.reason: Documented staging tooling; no corresponding source directory exists under supabase/functions in this branch.

appleCredentialFunctions.reason: Live staging deployment provenance (2026-08-29) shows these were deployed via a GitHub Actions checkout of this same repository (kscanaiapp/kscan-app), but neither exists in this branch's or either mobile branch's current supabase/functions tree. Origin commit/branch unconfirmed -- flagged for owner follow-up, not guessed at.

wearableFunctions.reason: Deployed from a different repository entirely (kscan-glasses-webapp, confirmed via each function's entrypoint_path on staging). Not governed here by design.
